description.value: Gibsons Landing Inn is a boutique hotel in the heart of the coastal town of Gibsons, BC, with a convenient waterfront location and walking distance to the Gibsons Public Market and local shops. Newly renovated rooms include kitchenettes and range from standard queens to balcony suites with ocean glimpses. Guests who book direct receive a credit toward Crazy Red's Breads Bakery in the adjacent Gibsons Public Market — a handy perk for an early-morning cycling departure.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully functional and confirms the OSM address (505 Gower Point Rd, Gibsons, BC V0N 1V8) and website URL. The phone number 1-604-740-2770 appears prominently on the website but is absent from the OSM record. Amenities listed on room pages (Free Wi-Fi, Laundry Facilities, Free Parking, Kitchenettes, Social Room) provide the primary basis for optional amenity answers; no bike-specific facilities are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Phone number 1-604-740-2770 is present on the website but missing from the OSM record; added from website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly bookable boutique hotel with a live website, confirmed address, and multiple room types — clearly a real, operating business useful to touring cyclists.
